sentimento.text1: In the Polymarket winner contract, Flávio Bolsonaro stands at 58.05% (USD 12.14M cumulative volume) and Lula at 41.50% (USD 12.52M cumulative volume), confirmed reading of 28/Sep, 13:49 BRT. Against the confirmed reading of 27/Sep at 12:47 BRT, Flávio Bolsonaro rises 0.80pp and Lula falls 1.00pp, and since the pair sum fell from 99.75 to 99.55 the normalized move is 0.92pp for each side. The gap over Lula widens from 14.75pp to 16.55pp, the third widening in a row between confirmed readings, after 22.40pp on 21/Sep, 19.05pp on 22/Sep, 18.35pp on 23/Sep, 12.05pp on 24 and 25/Sep, 13.65pp on 26/Sep and 14.75pp on 27/Sep.
sentimento.text2: 🗳️ TWO NATIONAL POLLS CAME OUT ON 28/Sep AND BOTH MEASURE LULA BETTER THAN THE WEEK BEFORE: [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) (BR-06520/2026, n=2,004, in-person, fieldwork from 24 to 27/Sep, margin of 2pp) has Lula 39% to 34% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) and 42% to 42% in the second, and BTG/Nexus (BR-07557/2026, n=2,000, telephone, fieldwork from 25 to 27/Sep, margin of 2pp) has Lula 42% to 37% in the first round and 46% to 44% in the second. In the 21/Sep wave, Quaest had 37% to 33% and Flávio Bolsonaro 42% to 41%, and BTG/Nexus 40% to 37% and 46% to 45%. ⚖️ Both were released on the morning of 28/Sep, before this reading, and both measure Lula in a better position than in the same pollster's 21/Sep wave, while the price moved the other way between the confirmed readings of 27 and 28/Sep. The panel records both with the timestamps of each and does not say which one is right. The presidential book received USD 0.45M of new money and totals USD 156.21M cumulative across 19 contracts.
sentimento.text3: 🥉 IN THE THIRD-PLACE BOOK OF THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) AUGUSTO CURY STAYS AHEAD, but the distance narrows: he rises 0.70pp, to 45.10% (USD 0.29M cumulative volume), and Renan Santos rises 1.50pp, to 43.00% (USD 0.45M), and the lead falls from 2.90pp to 2.10pp. Normalized by the book sum, which rose from 101.90 to 103.10, that is 0.17pp and 0.98pp. Ronaldo Caiado falls 1.00pp, to 13.50%. In the two national polls of the day the order is different: [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) has Caiado and Cury at 4% and Renan Santos at 3%, and BTG/Nexus has Cury and Caiado at 5% and Renan Santos at 4%. 📅 The [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) registry sets national releases for AtlasIntel, Palver, Vox Brasil, Real Time Big Data and JOTA on 29/Sep, Futura/100% Cidades, Indexa and Ideia on 30/Sep, Datafolha and Real Time Big Data on 01/Oct and Vox Brasil, Datavero and DataTrends on 02/Oct. A registered release is a commitment by the pollster, not a published number.
sentimento.direita: Flávio Bolsonaro at 58.05% in the winner contract (USD 12.14M cumulative volume), up 0.80pp raw and 0.92pp normalized, confirmed reading of 28/Sep, 13:49 BRT. He is 3.65pp from the top of the series, 61.70% on 21/Sep, and 36.05pp from the floor, 22.00% on 03/Jul. In the second-place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he stays at 74.50% (USD 1.25M), unchanged raw and up 0.68pp normalized. 🗳️ In the [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) poll of 28/Sep he has 34% in the first round and 42% in the second, tied, and in BTG/Nexus 37% and 44%. 📺 On 27/Sep, in Goiânia, he confirmed that he will attend the TV Globo debate of 01/Oct even without Lula (O Globo, G1 and Poder360). ⚖️ On 28/Sep his defence appealed to the Supreme Court against the ruling by Flávio Dino that cleared posts about Our Lady of Aparecida.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula at 41.50% in the winner contract (USD 12.52M cumulative volume), down 1.00pp raw and 0.92pp normalized, confirmed reading of 28/Sep, 13:49 BRT. ⚠️ It is not an extreme: he is 26.00pp from the top of the series, 67.50% on 16/Aug, and 7.00pp from the floor, 34.50% on 25/Apr. In the second-place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he falls 0.90pp, to 24.55% (USD 1.07M). 🗳️ In the [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) poll of 28/Sep he has 39% in the first round, 5 points ahead, and 42% in the second, tied, after being 1 point behind on 21/Sep; in BTG/Nexus he has 42% and 46%. Government approval in Quaest went from 44% to 46% and disapproval from 50% to 49%. 📺 His campaign had not confirmed attendance at the TV Globo debate as of 28/Sep.
sentimento.terceiraVia: 🥉 Augusto Cury stays ahead in the third-place book of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), with 45.10%, and Renan Santos is at 43.00%, 2.10pp behind; in the series of confirmed readings the distance was 19.95pp, 5.25pp, 3.05pp, 4.15pp, 4.05pp, 4.45pp and 4.15pp with Renan Santos ahead and 2.90pp and 2.10pp with Augusto Cury ahead. Ronaldo Caiado falls 1.00pp, to 13.50% (USD 0.18M volume), and Romeu Zema stays at 0.65%. 📺 The TV Globo debate of 01/Oct invited Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, Augusto Cury and Ronaldo Caiado, and Renan Santos was left out under the legal criterion of congressional representation (Folha de S.Paulo). In the winner book Renan Santos's contract falls to 0.35% and is still the one with the largest cumulative volume in the presidential book, USD 14.61M.
sentimento.polymarket: Prices from the confirmed reading of 28/Sep, 13:49 BRT (28/Sep, 16:49 UTC), with the presidential book totalling USD 156.21M cumulative across 19 contracts. AFOS only publishes a price that two independent readings, eight minutes apart, confirm within 0.20pp, contract by contract. Volume is cumulative since each contract opened. ⚖️ Alongside the raw move goes the one normalized by the pair sum, or by the whole book when it has more than two relevant names, because the sum of the prices moves on its own. 🗳️ The poll side of the divergence chart uses ONE national poll, not the average: the rule is the most recent one with ties broken by the largest sample, which gives [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep, n=2,004, and the choice is declared in the chart itself.

inss.text1: ⚖️ ON 25/Sep EDSON FACHIN GAVE THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL'S OFFICE (PGR) FIVE DAYS TO WEIGH IN ON THE PENDING REQUESTS IN THE [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) AND MASTER CASE INVESTIGATIONS, among them requests to review or revoke detentions, as Gazeta do Povo, G1 and Estadão report. The decision settles none of the requests: after the opinion, the case files go back to him. The investigations have been with the presidency of the Supreme Court since 12/Sep.
inss.text2: ⚠️ WHAT SITS OUTSIDE THE GOVERNMENT'S COUNT HAS A FIGURE, AND IT IS STILL THE ONE FROM 03/Sep. Requests delayed beyond 45 days totalled 261 thousand in August, against 1.88 million requests in the full queue. The page keeps the previous figure because there was no new measurement, and it does not estimate.
inss.text3: The definition the government uses, given by the Social Security minister and quoted by Metrópoles on 03/Sep, is that clearing the queue means analysing faster than the legal deadline of 45 days, not having no request under analysis. The two sentences describe different realities, and the distinction belongs to the vocabulary rather than to the measurement.
inss.text4: 📌 ALSO ON 25/Sep, FOLHA DE S.PAULO REPORTS THAT THE DEFENCE OF A FORMER [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) PRESIDENT TURNED TO THE PRESIDENCY OF THE SUPREME COURT against a detention that has lasted more than 300 days; the act has a single source and is included here with attribution. ⚖️ The personal link between the INSS and the Master case recorded on 24/Sep remains the same: the plane Flávio Bolsonaro travelled on in 2025, linked to Daniel Vorcaro and to a lawyer under investigation in the INSS fraud case, and which the senator says belongs to a lawyer friend.
inss.impactoLula: The approval benchmark of this panel is [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest), and the 28/Sep wave (BR-06520/2026, fieldwork from 24 to 27/Sep) measures 46% approval against 49% disapproval, against 44% and 50% on 21/Sep. BTG/Nexus of the same day measures the same 46% against 49%. ⚠️ In the five national polls of 24/Sep that measured approval it ranged from 41% at PoderData/Aya to 47% at Datafolha, and disapproval from 50% to 55%, so the reading of the two from 28/Sep falls within that week's range. The pollsters ask in different ways, and the panel does not add one to the other.
inss.impactoGestao: Within [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) itself the approval and disapproval series is this: 48% against 47% on 05/Aug, 46% against 48% on 14/Aug, 45% against 48% on 02/Sep, 43% against 50% on 07/Sep, 43% against 50% on 14/Sep, 44% against 50% on 21/Sep and 46% against 49% on 28/Sep. That is two waves in a row of rising approval, both within the margin of 2pp. ⭐ The ASSESSMENT benchmark moved little in the same wave: the negative went from 42% to 41%, the positive from 33% to 34% and the fair rating stayed at 23% (O Globo). These are two different questions and they do not add up.
inss.conclusao: What this round measures on the subject is still procedural, not about the merits: the five day window that Edson Fachin opened on 25/Sep for the Office of the Prosecutor-General to give its opinion on the pending requests in the [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) and Master case investigations runs until 30/Sep, and from 26 to 28/Sep there was no new act on the INSS. In the polls, the two national polls of 28/Sep measure government approval at 46% against 49%.

bancoMaster.text1: ⚖️ ON 25/Sep THE FEDERAL PROSECUTION SERVICE'S SUPERIOR COUNCIL KEPT THE PROSECUTOR-GENERAL, PAULO GONET, ON THE MASTER CASE PROCEEDINGS AND SHELVED THE REQUEST TO INVESTIGATE HIS CONDUCT. Against his removal the vote was 9-0. On the inquiry, which stood at 4-3 in favour of opening it with two votes still to be cast, the result was 5-4 for shelving, and the last vote was cast by the council's vice-president, Nicolao Dino, who was chairing the session because the proceeding involved Gonet himself (G1, Gazeta do Povo and O Globo). The rapporteur, Francisco Sanseverino, pointed out that the messages from Daniel Vorcaro's phone do not prove direct contact with the prosecutor-general, and the four defeated council members argued for appointing a deputy prosecutor-general to take the inquiry further, according to G1.
bancoMaster.text2: 📸 ESTADÃO, ON 25/Sep, AND VEJA, ON 26/Sep, REPORT THAT DANIEL VORCARO ATTENDED, ON 31 JANUARY 2024, A LUNCH HOSTED BY GRUPO ESFERA IN HONOUR OF GONET, in Brasília, with about 40 guests, which Gilmar Mendes also attended. VEJA publishes the banker's message from that day: "I'll be at the Esfera lunch with Gonet. Gilmar should be there". Gonet says he had no friendship with Vorcaro, and the banker's defence says it rejects the selective disclosure of private conversations. 📅 The five day deadline that Edson Fachin gave on 25/Sep for the Office of the Prosecutor-General to weigh in on the pending requests in the case is still open, among them those linked to the detentions of Henrique Vorcaro, Felipe Vorcaro, Fabiano Zettel and Daniel Lopes Monteiro.
bancoMaster.text3: ⚠️ The price on this page for the contract on a Supreme Court justice leaving by impeachment before 2027 comes from the confirmed reading of 28/Sep, 13:49 BRT, and stands at 2.95%, with USD 0.09M cumulative volume, practically unchanged against the confirmed reading of 27/Sep. AFOS does not attribute the price of that contract to the news flow of the case: it measures both side by side, each with its own timestamp. 🏷️ Still on the calendar, not completed acts, are the testimony of Gabriel Galípolo to the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf), expected in October, and that of Daniel Vorcaro, which was set for 24/Sep and was postponed at the request of the defence, according to Gazeta do Povo.
bancoMaster.conclusao: The case moved on 25/Sep through two procedural acts, not decisions on the merits: the Federal Prosecution Service's Superior Council kept Paulo Gonet on the proceedings by 9-0 and shelved by 5-4 the request to investigate his conduct, and Edson Fachin asked the Office of the Prosecutor-General for an opinion within five days on the pending requests. On 28/Sep, according to G1, Gilmar Mendes adjusted his vote in the ruling on whether Alexandre de Moraes should be investigated, so that it stays suspended until all the judges cited in the investigations are identified; the ruling has been stalled since 15/Sep by Flávio Dino's request for further review. The request to revoke Daniel Vorcaro's detention has been with Fachin since 18/Sep, undecided.

stf.toffoli: He is the justice with the highest rejection in the AtlasIntel poll in partnership with Estadão released on 23/Sep, a survey separate from the electoral one, with 1,852 adults interviewed between 17 and 21/Sep and a 2.0pp margin. On 24/Sep Folha de S.Paulo reports that he voted to remove an opponent of Davi Alcolumbre from the Amapá election and that André Mendonça interrupted the ruling; the act has a single source and is recorded here as attributed. He remains the target of the impeachment request filed by Renan Santos and of the inquiry committee request by Alessandro Vieira.
stf.moraes: The ruling opened on 15/Sep on whether he should be investigated over his relationship with Daniel Vorcaro still has no date, suspended by a request for further review by Flávio Dino. On 28/Sep, according to G1, Gilmar Mendes adjusted his vote in that ruling so that it stays suspended until all the judges cited in the investigations are identified, and proposed internal inquiries; the account comes from a single media group and is included here with attribution. On 25/Sep André Mendonça's filing on the report he used regarding that justice joined the list of pending requests that Edson Fachin sent to the Office of the Prosecutor-General, with a five day deadline. ⚖️ On the same day he was the rapporteur of the criminal case in which the Supreme Court convicted former congressman Eduardo Bolsonaro, 7-3, to one year of detention in an initially open regime for defamation against congresswoman Tabata Amaral.
stf.gilmar: On 28/Sep, according to G1, he adjusted his vote in the ruling on whether Alexandre de Moraes should be investigated, so that it stays suspended until all the judges cited in the Master case investigations are identified, and criticized André Mendonça's handling of the case; the account comes from a single media group and is included here with attribution. ⚖️ On 24/Sep he took to the full bench of the Supreme Court a dispute over power plant court-ordered debts (precatórios) with an estimated impact of R$ 103 billion, after messages from Daniel Vorcaro's phone showed interest in the vote of one justice in that case (O Globo, G1 and Gazeta do Povo). 📸 Estadão and VEJA report that he was at the Grupo Esfera lunch in honour of Paulo Gonet, on 31 January 2024, which Vorcaro attended, and on 26/Sep he publicly defended Gonet after the shelving (O Globo, Valor and Estadão).
stf.dino: ⚖️ On 27/Sep Supreme Court justice Flávio Dino, in a single-justice ruling on a complaint, overturned André Mendonça's order at the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) that required the deletion of a post by comedian Antonio Tabet about Our Lady of Aparecida and ordered the platforms to restore the posts removed on the same grounds (Jovem Pan and Brasil 247); on 28/Sep Flávio Bolsonaro's defence appealed and Dino sent the ruling for full-court review by the Supreme Court (G1 and Folha de S.Paulo). On 15/Sep he asked for further review in the ruling on the investigation into Alexandre de Moraes, which suspends the analysis for up to 90 days, and he had not returned the case by 28/Sep. On 22/Sep he said the right moment for the Supreme Court to examine the case on parliamentary earmarks is after the elections.
stf.mendonca: His 76 page filing, submitted on 21/Sep, asks Edson Fachin for the summary dismissal of the inquiry against him and for consideration of opening an investigation into Alexandre de Moraes for abuse of authority. On 25/Sep it joined the list of pending requests that Fachin sent to the Office of the Prosecutor-General, with a five day deadline. On 24/Sep his office received Flávio Bolsonaro's request to investigate the relationship between Lula and Daniel Vorcaro, and on 25/Sep Folha de S.Paulo reports that he keeps under seal the Master case proceeding in which he denied an operation against Cláudio Castro; the report has a single source and is included with attribution. 🗳️ Also on 25/Sep he ordered social networks to take down more than a thousand posts carrying the false story that Flávio Bolsonaro would strip Our Lady of Aparecida of the title of patron saint of Brazil (Gazeta do Povo, Folha de S.Paulo and CartaCapital), and in the criminal case against Eduardo Bolsonaro he voted for acquittal, defeated along with Luiz Fux and Nunes Marques.
stf.nexo: The link with the election is about the calendar and about institutions, not about the result, and there are two recent measurements of different questions, which do not add up. In the Datafolha poll released on 26/Sep, with fieldwork from 22 to 23/Sep, 33% say the conduct of the Supreme Court justices hurts Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy more and 23% say it hurts Lula's more (G1). In the AtlasIntel poll in partnership with Bloomberg of 23/Sep, 52.3% say the crisis at the Supreme Court hurts Lula's candidacy more and 20.8% say it hurts Flávio Bolsonaro's more. One question is about the conduct of the justices and the other about the crisis, and both pollsters surveyed the same week.
stf.analise: THE CONTRACT ON A SUPREME COURT JUSTICE LEAVING BY IMPEACHMENT BEFORE 2027 STANDS AT 2.95% (USD 0.09M cumulative volume), confirmed reading of 28/Sep, 13:49 BRT, practically unchanged against the confirmed reading of 27/Sep. It is a thin book, and the price is 23.15pp from the top of the series, 26.10% on 11/Sep, and 0.85pp from the floor, 2.10% on 08/Jun. ⚖️ The Supreme Court became the arena of two campaign clashes in the same week: on 27/Sep Supreme Court justice Flávio Dino, in a single-justice ruling on a complaint, overturned André Mendonça's order at the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) that required the deletion of a post by comedian Antonio Tabet about Our Lady of Aparecida and ordered the platforms to restore the posts removed on the same grounds (Jovem Pan and Brasil 247); on 28/Sep Flávio Bolsonaro's defence appealed and Dino sent the ruling for full-court review by the Supreme Court (G1 and Folha de S.Paulo); and on 28/Sep two betting associations asked Luiz Fux to suspend the provisional measure that bans betting sites (O Globo and Folha de S.Paulo), with no ruling as of this reading. ⛔ The panel does not link the price of the contract to the acts of the day: it measures both, each with its own timestamp.
stf.fachin: ⚖️ ON 25/Sep HE GAVE THE OFFICE OF THE PROSECUTOR-GENERAL FIVE DAYS TO WEIGH IN ON THE PENDING REQUESTS IN THE MASTER CASE AND [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) INVESTIGATIONS, which have been with the presidency of the Supreme Court since 12/Sep, and only after the opinion will he decide on them (Gazeta do Povo, G1 and Estadão). Since 18/Sep he has had on his desk the request to revoke Daniel Vorcaro's pre-trial detention, undecided as of 27/Sep, and on 24/Sep Flávio Bolsonaro's defence asked him to suspend the investigations that reach the senator, as O Globo reports.
